meta.name: hypothesis-generation
meta.description: Structured hypothesis formulation from observations. Use when you have experimental observations or data and need to formulate testable hypotheses with predictions, propose mechanisms, and design experiments to test them. Follows scientific method framework. For open-ended ideation use scientific-brainstorming; for automated LLM-driven hypothesis testing on datasets use hypogenic.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将观察转化为可检验的假设与实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有实验数据或观察结果，需要系统性地提出科学假设并设计验证实验。
copy.tagline_en: Turn observations into testable hypotheses and experiments

howto.what: Claude 会根据你提供的观察或数据，系统性地生成可检验的科学假设，包括提出机制、设计实验和预测结果，并输出带示意图的 LaTeX 报告。
howto.when: 当你需要从实验观察或数据出发，提出可检验的假设并设计实验来验证时触发。

say.text: 根据这些细胞实验数据，帮我生成几个可能的假设。
say.note: Claude 会分析数据并输出假设报告。

say.text: 我观察到植物在红光下生长更快，请提出竞争性假设。
say.note: Claude 会生成多个假设并设计实验。

howto.what_en: Claude systematically generates testable scientific hypotheses from your observations or data, including mechanisms, experiments, and predictions, and outputs a LaTeX report with diagrams.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to formulate testable hypotheses from experimental observations or data and design experiments to test them.

say_en.text: Based on these cell experiment data, help me generate several possible hypotheses.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the data and output a hypothesis report.

say_en.text: I observed plants grow faster under red light; propose competing hypotheses.
say_en.note: Claude will generate multiple hypotheses and design experiments.
